deeper.summary: Push-your-luck dungeon descent. One torch lights one run. Bank the pot or descend for a bigger one.

consumableRules.consumedAt: the dungeon entrance, when the run is committed
consumableRules.note: One torch lights one run and reserves the maximum prize (25 RF) for its whole length. Purchased torches stay usable; kept caches keep their fixed RF value with no redemption expiry.

deeper.potLadderNote: Pot value by loot tier, not by depth. An EMPTY room advances depth without advancing tier, so a deep run can still carry a shallow pot.

fairness.roomDraw: sha256(runNonce + ':' + playId + ':' + depth) -> first 8 hex digits as uint32 -> roll = value mod 10000 (2^32 is not a multiple of 10000, so 7296 buckets hold one extra preimage: a 15.00% band is really 15.0000094%)
fairness.roomOrder: roll < trapBps -> TRAP; else roll < trapBps + lootBps -> LOOT; else EMPTY
fairness.note: The nonce is drawn and committed before the first room, so no room result can react to a BANK or DESCEND choice. It is withheld until the run ends -- a nonce in hand would reveal every room below you -- and revealed with the result, so every room is recomputable from it.

deeper.ledgerNote: SDK v0.1 pays one fixed reward per settled draw, so a payout that depends on the player's stop depth is not expressible on-chain yet. Torch purchase, torch burn, the 25 RF reserve and cache settlement all run through the SDK client; the banked pot is a labelled simulated reward. See README.md 'Capability gap'.
